description: A timed visual-search concentration test developed by Raatz and Möhling in which young children mark target pears among distractor apples.
title: FTF-K Attention Test for Children of Age 5-6 (Frankfurter Tests für Fünfjährige-Konzentration)

description: A workshop implementation package that provides the structure, materials, and session instructions for running Future Technology Workshops, enabling facilitators to conduct participatory design with children or adults without specialist software-design training.
title: FTW toolkit for running Future Technology Workshops
